question: Kinsa ang kailangan mukuha ug Occupational Permit, pila ang bayad, ug pila ang multa kung ma-late ug renew pagkahuman sa January 31?
answer:
Ang kailangan mukuha nga Occupational Permit ay mga trabahante o empleyado nga wala'y valid na Professional Tax Receipt (PTR). Ang bayad sa Occupational Permit ay Php125 para sa bag-ong ug updated renewal, at Php156.25 para sa late renewal. Ang multa kung ma-late ang renewal pagkahuman sa January 31 ay 25%.

ground_truth: An Occupational Permit is required for workers not holding a Professional Tax Receipt (PTR). It must be renewed annually on or before January 31; late renewal incurs a statutory 25% penalty. Fees are PHP 125.00 for new applications and timely renewals, and PHP 156.25 for late renewals. Requirements include: 1) Application form; 2) Certificate of Employment; 3) Official Receipt from CTO; 4) Notarized Affidavit of Consent for minors below 18 (or ages 18-20 for amusement places/bars); and 5) PSA Birth Certificate, Health ID, and interview for entertainers, masseurs, and bar attendants.
